items.author: JustinGastby

items.title: 【开源自荐】SlideTalk 是一款功能强大的桌面应用，能够将 PowerPoint 演示文稿自动转换为有声视频讲解。通过集成 AI 语音合成和视频编辑功能，让您的演示文稿动起来！
items.author: weibiaoyi
items.content: https://github.com/weibiaoyi/SlideTalk # SlideTalk - 幻灯片说客 > 将 PPT 自动转换为有声视频讲解的桌面客户端 ![img.png](resources/img.png) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-green.svg)](package.json) [![Electron](https://img.shields.io/badge/Electron-33-blue.svg)](https://www.electronjs.org/) [![Vue](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vue-3.5-green.svg)](https://vuejs.org/) 🌐 **语言切换**: [English](README.en.md) ## 🌟 项目简介 SlideTalk 是一款功能强大的桌面应用，能够将 PowerPoint 演示文稿自动转换为有声视频讲解。通过集成 AI 语音合成和视频编辑功能，让您的演示文稿动起来！ ## ✨ 核心功能 | 功能模块 | 描述 | |---------|------| | **PPT 导入解析** | 支持 .ppt/.pptx/.pdf 文件，自动提取每页内容和备注，生成高清缩略图 | | **文案编辑** | 每页独立文案编辑，支持 AI 智能改写、扩写、精简 | | **语音合成** | 多音色选择，语速/语调/音量可调，支持声音克隆（参考音频） | | **字幕配置** | 每页字幕内容编辑 + 全局样式设置 | | **背景音乐** | 内置音乐库 + BGM 全局配置（音量/淡入淡出） | | **视频导出** | 支持多种格式、分辨率、帧率、画质设置，实时进度展示 | | **主题切换** | 深色/浅色/跟随系统三种主题，即时生效 | | **项目管理** | 支持搜索、排序、重命名、删除项目 | ## 🛠️ 技术栈 ### 前端 | 技术 | 版本 | 用途 | |------|------|------| | Vue | 3.5+ | 前端框架 | | TypeScript | 5.7+ | 类型安全 | | Pinia | 2.3+ | 状态管理 | | Vue Router | 4.5+ | 路由管理 | | Lucide Vue | 0.469+ | 图标库 | | Vite | 6.0+ | 构建工具 | ### 桌面 | 技术 | 版本 | 用途 | |------|------|------| | Electron | 33+ | 桌面应用框架 | | electron-builder | 25+ | 打包工具 | ### 后端 | 技术 | 用途 | |------|------| | Python | 后端语言 | | FastAPI | API 框架 | | PyMuPDF | PDF 解析与图片转换 | | python-pptx | PPTX 文件解析 | | ffmpeg | 视频合成与音频混音 | | comtypes | Windows COM 自动化（PowerPoint/WPS） | ## 📁 项目结构 ``` SlideTalk/ ├── electron/ # Electron 主进程 │ ├── main.ts # 主进程入口（窗口管理、IPC） │ ├── preload.ts # 预加载脚本（contextBridge） │ ├── shared/ │ │ └── ipc-types.ts # IPC 类型定义 │ └── services/ │ ├── index.ts # 服务注册 │ ├── pythonService.ts # Python 后端进程管理 │ ├── mock/ # Mock 服务实现（开发测试） │ │ ├── pptParser.ts # Mock PPT 解析 │ │ ├── ttsService.ts # Mock 语音合成 │ │ ├── llmService.ts # Mock AI 改写 │ │ ├── videoExporter.ts # Mock 视频导出 │ │ └── seedData.ts # 示例项目数据 │ └── real/ │ └── backendClient.ts # 真实后端 API 调用 ├── ppt-video-backend/ # Python 后端服务 │ ├── app.py # FastAPI 入口 │ ├── core.py # 核心业务逻辑 │ └── requirements.txt # Python 依赖 ├── src/ # 前端渲染层 │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── common/ # 通用组件（Button/Input/Modal 等） │ │ ├── editor/ # 编辑器组件 │ │ ├── export/ # 导出相关组件 │ │ ├── home/ # 首页组件 │ │ └── layout/ # 布局组件（Titlebar/Sidebar） │ ├── composables/ # 组合式函数（useTheme/useToast） │ ├── router/ # 路由配置 │ ├── stores/ # Pinia 状态管理 │ ├── services/ # 渲染层服务抽象 │ ├── styles/ # 全局样式与主题 │ ├── types/ # TypeScript 类型定义 │ ├── views/ # 页面视图 │ ├── App.vue # 根组件 │ └── main.ts # 应用入口 ├── public/ # 静态资源 │ └── voices/ # 预置音色示例 ├── resources/ # 打包资源（图标） ├── dist/ # 前端构建产物（自动生成） ├── dist-electron/ # Electron 构建产物（自动生成） ├── release/ # 打包输出目录（自动生成） ├── package.json # 项目依赖与脚本 ├── vite.config.ts # Vite 配置 ├── tsconfig.json # TypeScript 配置 └── README.md # 项目说明文档 ``` ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 环境要求 - **Node.js**: >= 20.x - **Python**: >= 3.10 - **ffmpeg**: 需安装并添加到系统 PATH - **PPT 转 PDF 引擎**（任选其一）: - Microsoft PowerPoint（推荐） - WPS Office - LibreOffice ### 安装依赖 ```bash # 安装前端依赖 npm install # 安装后端依赖（进入后端目录） cd ppt-video-backend pip install -r requirements.txt cd .. ``` > **Electron 下载加速**（国内网络）： > ```bash > # Windows (PowerShell) > $env:ELECTRON_MIRROR="https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/" > npm install > ``` ### 开发模式 ```bash npm run dev ``` 启动 Vite 开发服务器 + Electron 主进程，支持热更新。 ### 类型检查 ```bash npm run typecheck ``` ### 构建项目 ```bash npm run build ``` ### 打包 Windows 安装包 ```bash npm run build:win ``` 产物输出到 `release/` 目录： - `SlideTalk-Setup-1.0.0.exe` - NSIS 安装包 - `SlideTalk-1.0.0-portable.exe` - 免安装便携版 ## 🔌 后端服务配置 ### 启动 Python 后端 ```bash cd ppt-video-backend python app.py ``` 默认端口：`17878` ### 健康检查 ```bash curl http://localhost:17878/health ``` 返回示例： ```json { "status": "ok", "version": "1.0.0", "ppt_engines": [ {"name": "powerpoint", "display": "Microsoft PowerPoint", "available": true, "path": null}, {"name": "wps", "display": "WPS Office", "available": false, "path": null}, {"name": "libreoffice", "display": "LibreOffice", "available": true, "path": "C:\\Program Files\\LibreOffice\\program\\soffice.exe"} ], "ppt_engines_available": ["powerpoint", "libreoffice"], "soffice": "C:\\Program Files\\LibreOffice\\program\\soffice.exe", "ffmpeg": "ffmpeg" } ``` ### 外部服务配置 #### TTS 服务（OmniVoice） 1. 安装 OmniVoice 服务（参考 [OmniVoice 文档](https://github.com/OmniVoice/OmniVoice)） 2. 启动 TTS 服务（默认端口 8002） 3. 在应用设置中配置 TTS 服务地址 #### LLM 服务 在应用设置中配置： - API Key - API Base URL（支持 OpenAI 兼容接口） - Model 名称 ## 📡 API 接口 ### 1. PPT 解析 ``` POST /api/parse-ppt Content-Type: application/json { "file_path": "C:/path/to/presentation.pptx", "thumb_dir": "C:/path/to/thumbs" } ``` ### 2. 语音合成 ``` POST /api/tts-single Content-Type: application/json { "text": "这是一段测试文本", "tts_endpoint": "http://localhost:8002", "ref_audio_path": "C:/path/to/reference.wav", "language": "zh" } ``` ### 3. AI 改写 ``` POST /api/llm-rewrite Content-Type: application/json { "text": "原始文本", "mode": "rewrite", "api_key": "your-api-key", "api_base": "https://api.example.com/v1", "model": "gpt-4" } ``` ### 4. 视频导出 ``` POST /api/export-video Content-Type: application/json { "ppt_path": "C:/path/to/presentation.pptx", "narrations": ["第一页旁白", "第二页旁白", "..."], "output_path": "C:/path/to/output.mp4", "tts_endpoint": "http://localhost:8002", "resolution": "1920:1080", "bgm_path": "C:/path/to/bgm.mp3", "bgm_volume": 0.10 } ``` ### 5. 进度查询（WebSocket） ``` GET /ws/progress/{task_id} ``` ## 🎨 主题系统 应用内置三套主题： | 主题 | 描述 | |------|------| | **深色** | 剪映青蓝深色风格（默认） | | **浅色** | 清爽浅色风格 | | **跟随系统** | 自动适配操作系统主题 | 主题切换采用双写方案（localStorage + IPC 持久化），HTML 内联脚本防闪烁。 ## 📝 Mock 模式说明 开发环境默认使用 Mock 模式，所有业务接口均为模拟实现： | 接口 | Mock 行为 | |------|-----------| | PPT 解析 | 接受任意文件，模拟 2-3 秒解析，生成纯色占位缩略图 | | 语音合成 | 返回模拟音频 URL | | AI 改写 | 模拟 1-2 秒延迟，返回原文 + 模式后缀 | | 视频导出 | 4 阶段进度模拟，约 5 秒完成 | **切换到真实后端**：修改 `electron/services/index.ts` 中的服务注册逻辑。 ## 🐛 常见问题 ### Q: `npm install` 时 Electron 下载失败？ A: 设置 Electron 镜像： ```bash $env:ELECTRON_MIRROR="https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/" npm install ``` ### Q: PPT 解析失败？ A: 检查是否安装了 PPT 转 PDF 引擎（PowerPoint/WPS/LibreOffice），或尝试将 PPT 另存为 PDF 后直接导入。 ### Q: 视频导出失败？ A: 检查： 1. ffmpeg 是否安装并添加到 PATH 2. 输出目录是否有写权限 3. TTS 服务是否正常运行 ### Q: 打包后启动白屏？ A: 检查 `package.json` 的 `build.directories.output` 是否为 `release`（不能是 `dist`）。 ### Q: 主题切换后样式不生效？ A: 组件内样式必须使用 CSS 变量（`var(--bg-1)` 等），不能硬编码颜色。 ## 🤝 贡献指南 欢迎贡献代码！请遵循以下规范： 1. Fork 项目 2. 创建功能分支（`feature/xxx`） 3. 提交代码（遵循 Conventional Commits） 4. 创建 Pull Request ## 讨论群 ![my.jpg](resources/my.jpg) ## 📄 许可证 MIT License - 详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) ## 🙏 致谢 - [Vue.js](https://vuejs.org/) - 前端框架 - [Electron](https://www.electronjs.org/) - 桌面应用框架 - [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) - API 框架 - [PyMuPDF](https://pymupdf.readthedocs.io/) - PDF 处理 - [OmniVoice](https://github.com/OmniVoice/OmniVoice) - 语音合成 - [Lucide](https://lucide.com/) - 图标库 --- **SlideTalk** - 让您的幻灯片开口说话 🎤

Birth 是一款免费开源的 macOS 启动项管理工具。macOS 把启动项分散在至少四套机制里(用户/全局 LaunchAgents、LaunchDaemons、登录项),系统设置里只显示为语焉不详的"后台项目"——不告诉你 plist 在哪、指向哪个可执行文件、由谁签名,第三方的更新器、辅助进程和赖着不走的卸载残留,正是仰仗这种不透明。Birth 把它们收进同一个窗口:每一项标出开发者签名身份(经证书链锚点验证)和实时运行状态,支持一键启停和安全删除(先停止任务,plist 移入废纸篓并自动保留备份)。

一个值得一提的功能是伪装检测:恶意软件最常用的持久化伪装手法,是把标识符起成 `com.apple.*` 混进系统项里。Birth 对每一项做签名验证,标识符冒充 Apple 但证书链对不上的,会被红色"伪装系统项"直接标出。

- SwiftUI 原生,零第三方依赖,MIT 协议

items.author: seqradev
items.summary: 项目地址 类别 其它 项目标题 AI 智能体驱动的开源污点分析（SAST）引擎 项目描述 OpenTaint 是一款面向 AI 智能体设计的开源污点分析（SAST）引擎。在一次安全审计中，AI 智能体把学到的东西落实下来：把漏洞模式沉淀为污点规则（禁止某一类数据流路径），把代码行为沉淀为摘要（让引擎看穿它从未分析过的代码）。此后引擎复用这些规则与摘要，而不再重复昂贵的分析——学习只做一次，搜索在每次扫描时持续进行，安全审计因此精简而持续。它是 Semgrep Pro 与 CodeQL 的 AIready 开源替代品。 亮点 同时守住静态分析经典「三难」的三个角——扫描时间、误报、漏报：在大规模代码上跨过程、字段与别名追踪数据流。学习昂贵且不可预测、只做一次；搜索廉价且确定、每次扫描复用，不必逐次消耗大模型 token。开源 Apache2.0，可自托管、可定制。 截图或演示视频 !OpenTaint 演示

### 项目描述

OpenTaint 是一款面向 AI 智能体设计的开源污点分析（SAST）引擎。在一次安全审计中，AI 智能体把学到的东西落实下来：把漏洞模式沉淀为污点规则（禁止某一类数据流路径），把代码行为沉淀为摘要（让引擎看穿它从未分析过的代码）。此后引擎复用这些规则与摘要，而不再重复昂贵的分析——学习只做一次，搜索在每次扫描时持续进行，安全审计因此精简而持续。它是 Semgrep Pro 与 CodeQL 的 AI-ready 开源替代品。

同时守住静态分析经典「三难」的三个角——扫描时间、误报、漏报：在大规模代码上跨过程、字段与别名追踪数据流。学习昂贵且不可预测、只做一次；搜索廉价且确定、每次扫描复用，不必逐次消耗大模型 token。开源 Apache-2.0，可自托管、可定制。

items.title: CartesiumAI
items.summary: Learn by experimenting with a real-time AI companion
items.content: CartesiumAI turns learning into a live, evidence-driven process. Its context-aware 3D companion explains selected concepts, reads the learner’s journal and simulation state, and performs safe real-time demonstrations. Ten deterministic physics labs let learners predict, experiment, collect evidence, revise explanations, and build auditable reports. This can be extended to any other discipline, leading to a high-quality learning experience. Built end to end with Codex and designed for GPT-5.6.

items.title: SMASH Voice to Invoice
items.summary: Build and send quotes as fast as you can talk
items.content: I built this because every quote request cost me time and money. I'd stop working, scramble to remember my rates, type out a quote, lose the job to someone faster. SMASH lets me quote into my phone while I'm still on site. Talk the details, it pulls from my own pricing, sends instantly. Customer approves right there, I get paid, I keep moving. No context switching. No guessing rates. Just my numbers, my speed. Free on the App Store and Chrome extension. Five quotes a month free, full featured.

items.title: Foalia
items.summary: The ultimate SaaS platform for equine breeding management
items.content: Foalia is the ultimate SaaS platform designed to streamline equine breeding management. Say goodbye to messy spreadsheets and hello to smart, centralized tracking for your mares, veterinary schedules, and breeding statistics. Built by breeders for breeders, Foalia helps you save time, reduce errors, and make data-driven decisions for your stud farm. Manage your entire breeding operation effortlessly in one clean, powerful workspace.

items.title: XERIA
items.summary: Secure, personalize, send and trace PDF documents
items.content: Secure PDF distribution with personalized watermarking, source identification, password protection, and traceability. XERIA generates recipient-specific PDFs, adds visible watermarks and embedded trace information, and helps organizations control confidential document sharing. Designed for training, legal, HR, and compliance teams. Now available on Microsoft Store, with an unlimited free trial before purchasing a license.

items.title: AI Act Compliance Navigator
items.summary: Explainable AI compliance, grounded in evidence and action
items.content: AI Act Compliance Navigator turns a company questionnaire into an explainable EU AI Act and GDPR risk profile. Built with Codex and GPT-5.6 Sol, it combines deterministic scoring, source-linked regulatory intelligence, a grounded assistant, policy guardrails, multilingual workflows, and a Compliance Action Workspace to assign owners, due dates, evidence, and human approval. Unlike a generic legal chatbot, every recommendation stays connected to the company profile and reviewable evidence.

items.title: AlphaWatching
items.summary: 10 AI agents turning market data into clear signals
items.content: AlphaWatching brings crypto, global stocks, Turkish stocks (BIST) and mutual funds (TEFAS) into one AI-powered analysis experience. Ten specialized agents examine market regime, technical signals, quantitative data, news, sentiment, volume, flows and risk. A Decision Agent combines the findings into a clear 0–100 score, key drivers and possible scenarios—without connecting to your broker or accessing your funds.

items.title: Trend Seeker
items.summary: Market research and idea validation from 140K+ signals
items.content: Trend Seeker turns recurring demand from Reddit, job ads, podcasts, Google Trends, and product launches into business ideas you can inspect. Each idea shows the problem, source signals, demand trend, competition, opportunity score, and how the cluster changed over time. Browse 7.4K ideas built from 140K+ signals, explore the Demand Map, or validate your own idea against matching user requests. Free to explore, with Pro for full access.

items.title: Framewritten
items.summary: Turn any website into a finished marketing video
items.content: Paste your website. Framewritten reads your business, writes the script, generates the voiceover, builds the visuals in code and delivers a finished, publish-ready marketing video in around 10 minutes. No templates, no timelines and no video editing. Just a video that's built around your business and ready to share.

items.title: AI Dimag
items.summary: Verified memory for AI coding agents that proves it's true
items.content: AI Dimag gives MCP-compatible agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf) persistent memory that survives across sessions. Unlike traditional context systems, every memory carries falsifiable evidence—shell checks, tests, commit anchors—that dim verify re-runs against your current repo. Stale beliefs get flagged instead of silently misleading your AI. Works via MCP tools for real-time memory or generates static context files (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md) for non-MCP tools. Free for teams ≤10.

items.title: CRC Toolbox
items.summary: Zero-PHI, client-side utilities for clinical research teams
items.content: Enterprise clinical tools require logins and IT reviews just to run basic math. CRC Toolbox eliminates site friction with browser-native utilities that run 100% client-side without collecting PHI—safe for independent trial sites. Full Utility Suite: • Kit expiration tracker & lab specimen workbench • CAPA & deviation drafter • Visit window math with directics export • Instant CTCAE toxicity & lab criteria search • Clinical calculators (BSA, QTc) & GCP checklists Free, instant, 100% private.

items.title: LABO AI
items.summary: Visual AI lab for designing neural networks
items.content: LABO AI is a visual workspace for designing, exploring, and executing neural network architectures directly in the browser. Build models by connecting typed blocks, inspect the generated PyTorch code in real time, execute graphs locally, and collaborate with AI agents that help design and refine architectures. Built for researchers, engineers, educators, and anyone exploring modern deep learning.

items.title: Fastrr by Shiprocket
items.summary: India’s first AI‑native growth suite for eCommerce brands
items.content: Fastrr by Shiprocket is India's first AI-native pre-order commerce suite that helps eCommerce brands convert more visitors into customers. It brings together 11 AI-powered tools for checkout, shopping assistance, visitor identification, marketing automation, customer journeys, AI voice agents, performance marketing, and conversion optimization—all on one platform. Replace fragmented tools, engage shoppers smarter, and grow revenue with AI.

items.title: Tiny Brush Colouring Games App
items.summary: Kids Fun Coloring Drawing Book
items.content: Looking for a fun and creative way to keep your kids entertained? Try Tiny Brush! This app offers plenty of coloring and drawing fun for kids of all ages. Let your child explore a world of color with our easy-to-use Coloring Games! With themes like animals, food, vehicles, shapes, geometry and nature, young artists can enjoy a creative adventure that sparks their imagination.

items.title: Basement
items.summary: Shopping browser with agentic checkout
items.content: Basement is now a shopping browser. Today we launch agentic checkout: your AI shopper finds the best price across the web and buys it for you. Every purchase runs on a single-use card scoped to one order, so your real card is never exposed and nothing goes beyond the budget you set. Every payment lands in one place. Powered by Crossmint. It knows what you like. Now it can buy it. Live on iOS and Chrome.

items.title: TrustGrowth
items.summary: SEO you can verify. Open playbook. Public proof.
items.content: Every SEO tool gives you a report. Ours gives you proof. We audit your site from Search Console evidence into one verified TrustGrowth Score — technical SEO, performance, E-E-A-T, keywords, strategy — and publish it as a public proof page, weak signals included, with an embeddable badge and a rank on the public leaderboard. You approve what changes. The playbook we work from, Groundcrew, is open source: inspect the exact instructions, or run them with your own agent. Claim your rank.

items.title: PastWisdom Quote Verification
items.summary: Verify the source behind famous quotes ⭐
items.content: PastWisdom now verifies the origins and attribution of famous quotes. Instead of simply showing who a quote is credited to, we research books, speeches, interviews, archives, and other published sources to determine whether the attribution is accurate. Each quote is labeled Verified, Attributed, Unverified, Disputed, or Misattributed, with its source, context, wording variants, and an editorial explanation. It’s a more trustworthy way to discover, share, & cite words that shape our thinking.

items.title: LSwitch | One Line to Go Multilingual
items.summary: Add multilingual support to any website with one line
items.content: Add multilingual support to any website with one line of code. Building a multilingual site usually means translation services, separate domains, and a lot of efforts to create text content. Paste one script tag into your HTML and a language switcher widget appears instantly. Powered by Google Translate, 100+ languages, zero backend required. Images and logos stay untouched so your design stays intact.

items.title: Realisio
items.summary: Turn property photos into sales ready visuals with AI
items.content: Realisio turns ordinary property photos into sales ready visuals in about 20 seconds. Stage interiors, transform exteriors, preview real roof products, improve lighting and create floor plans. Built for agents, agencies and developers who want buyers to see the potential before the first viewing.

items.title: Citability Scorer
items.summary: Score a page against the 5 criteria AI uses to cite sources
items.content: AI answers cite one or two sources and erase everyone else. Enter a URL and the question you want to win. The scorer reads your live page and grades it 0-100 the way models pick sources: answer position, structure, facts, entities, freshness. Free, no signup.

items.title: Ledgora
items.summary: Private cash-flow forecasting for Windows.
items.content: Ledgora is a privacy-first financial forecasting program built specifically for Windows. Unlike cloud-based budgeting apps, it keeps your financial records locally and works without requiring constant internet access. Ledgora goes beyond tracking past spending by forecasting cash flow, recurring bills, income, debt, account balances, savings goals, and what-if scenarios—helping you see what may happen before making financial decisions.
